text: I need some advice urgently please. My granddaughter is only 1 month old and her temperature is 39.6. I was changing her and I saw little purple red marks on her tummy and some on her back, like tiny pinpricks, and one bigger bit that looks like a bruise. I pressed a glass against them and they're still there, they didn't fade at all. I'm shaking, I don't know whether to wait for her mum to get home or just go
